title: Querying Your Developer ID and Project ID

notes.text: To find you developer ID and project ID, perform the following steps:
Sign in to AppGallery Connect and click Development and services.
Find your project from the project list and choose the app for which you need to query the developer ID or project ID.
Go to Project settings > General information and check the Developer ID and Project ID parameters.

renderedText:
Querying Your Developer ID and Project ID
Last updated: 2026-04-09 17:57

To find you developer ID and project ID, perform the following steps:

Sign in to AppGallery Connect and click Development and services.
Find your project from the project list and choose the app for which you need to query the developer ID or project ID.
Go to Project settings > General information and check the Developer ID and Project ID parameters.
